description: This file contains Go source code implementing functions for extracting managed fields into configuration objects within Kubernetes, specifically handling unstructured and structured objects, and managing metadata related to managed fields.

methods.name: ExtractInto
methods.description: Extracts the applied configuration state from an object for a specified field manager into an apply configuration object, handling unstructured and structured objects, and managing metadata.

methods.name: findManagedFields
methods.description: Finds and returns the managed fields entry for a given field manager and subresource from an object's metadata.

methods.name: toTyped
methods.description: Converts a runtime.Object to a typed.TypedValue using the provided ParseableType, handling unstructured and structured objects.
